author: Yffe
content: Lexer + recursive-descent parser to AST. Two hard requirements from the design: (a) PER-ITEM error recovery — a syntax error in one item must not cascade into the next (design 4.3); parse items independently. (b) STABLE SEMANTIC ADDRESSING — deterministic numbering loop#1, inv#2, etc. (design 4.3) that survives unrelated edits, so forge edit-by-address and per-item proof cache keys work. Mandatory-contract enforcement: absent req/ens/fx is a parse error, not a default (design 4.1).
